why.zh: 从真实页面录下的操作演示：单步看两次试探交换、负收益让 cut 暂升到 11、回退到最佳前缀，第二轮空前缀停止；换种子 AB | CDE 停在 5，把 A–B 改成 1 重算收益；再在浏览器里写完 best_swap() 和 best_prefix() 并通过全部检查。
why.en: Recorded from the real page: stepping through two trial swaps, a negative gain lifting the cut to 11, the roll-back to the best prefix and the empty prefix that stops pass 2; seed AB | CDE stuck at 5, and A–B set to 1 to recompute the gains; then writing best_swap() and best_prefix() in the browser and passing every check.
